nodes.label: GitNexus Code Intelligence Index
nodes.rationale: MUST run impact analysis (impact({target,direction:'upstream'})) before editing any function/class/method and report blast radius; MUST run detect_changes() before committing to verify only expected symbols/flows changed; MUST warn on HIGH/CRITICAL risk before proceeding; use query({search_query}) instead of grepping to find execution flows; use context({name}) for full caller/callee context; use explain({target}) for taint source->sink findings. Indexes AI_TC_Generator_v04_w_Trainer as 3797 symbols, 5741 relationships, 130 execution flows.

nodes.label: Graphify Knowledge Graph (AGENTS.md rule)
nodes.rationale: For codebase questions, run `graphify query "<question>"` first when graphify-out/graph.json exists (scoped subgraph, smaller than GRAPH_REPORT.md or raw grep). Dirty graphify-out/ files after hooks/incremental updates are expected and not a reason to skip graphify. Use wiki/index.md for broad navigation over raw source browsing; read GRAPH_REPORT.md only for broad architecture review. Run `graphify update .` after modifying code to keep the AST-derived graph current at no API cost.

nodes.label: Codebase Architecture & Investigation Workflow
nodes.rationale: Mandates a synergistic two-step tool chain for architecture/dependency/execution-flow analysis: Step 1 (Strict Code) use GitNexus MCP tools (impact/trace/context) to map execution paths, method resolutions, code-level dependencies; Step 2 (Rationale & Docs) use the Graphify skill to query markdown docs/PDFs/inline comments for the design rationale behind that flow. Explicitly forbids blindly grepping or reading raw files to understand system architecture: GitNexus answers 'how', Graphify answers 'why'.

nodes.label: Context-Aware Processing (BaseProcessor._build_augmented_requirements)
nodes.rationale: DO NOT BREAK core context loop: interface text is normalised once before the loop; on each Heading, current_heading updates and info_since_heading resets; on each Information block, cleaned text is appended to info_since_heading; on each System Requirement, the augmented requirement is stamped with heading/info_list/interface_list and info_since_heading is reset immediately after (CRITICAL). Rules: never filter artifacts before this loop (kills context); never duplicate this logic in individual processors (use inheritance instead); never remove heading/info_list/interface_list from PromptBuilder templates; _clean_text_for_logging must keep handling str|list|None because the REQIFZ extractor can return text as a list of XML node strings that all downstream code expects as plain strings.

nodes.label: Hybrid Vision Strategy (Critical Architecture)
nodes.rationale: Per-requirement model selection is centralized in ConfigManager.get_model_for_requirement() (src/config.py:487): a requirement that has images uses llama3.2-vision:11b via generate_response_with_vision(); a requirement without images uses llama3.1:8b via generate_completion(). Model selection must never be hardcoded in processors so the hybrid strategy stays centrally tunable in one place (ConfigManager).

nodes.label: Canonical Test-Case Schema
nodes.rationale: The one true schema emitted by the active adaptive template and expected everywhere downstream is: summary_suffix, preconditions, test_steps, expected_result, test_type. TestCaseDeduplicator.DEFAULT_FIELDS_TO_COMPARE=[test_steps, expected_result, preconditions] must never reintroduce the retired action/data schema — doing so made every pair look nearly identical and silently deleted legitimate test cases (2026-07-05 review finding §1.1). stamp_validation_results must run BEFORE dedup so dedup's 'best' keep-strategy reads the validation_passed flag with indices still aligned; validating after dedup misaligns indices.

nodes.label: Excel Formatter 16-Column Schema
nodes.rationale: Excel export requires exactly 16 columns with specific names: column 13 must be 'Feature Group', column 16 must be 'LinkTest' (not 'Tests'). TestCaseFormatter and StreamingTestCaseFormatter must be changed together whenever columns change, otherwise HP-mode Excel export crashes from column count/name mismatches.

nodes.label: REQIF Attribute Mapping
nodes.rationale: REQIFArtifactExtractor maps internal identifiers like _json2reqif_XXX to human-readable names like 'ReqIF.Text' via _build_attribute_definition_mapping(); bypassing or removing this mapping causes requirements to be skipped with 'no text content' errors.

nodes.label: __slots__ Pattern on Core Classes
nodes.rationale: Core classes (generators, deduplicator, clients) declare __slots__ for memory/perf reasons; adding a new instance attribute requires adding it to the slots tuple first, otherwise it raises AttributeError at runtime instead of silently succeeding.

nodes.label: RAFT Fine-Tuning Pipeline (src/training)
nodes.rationale: src/training implements RAFTDataCollector (collects examples during normal runs), RAFTAnnotator (expert annotation support), RAFTDatasetBuilder, ProgressiveRAFTTrainer (curriculum learning), VisionRAFTTrainer, and QualityScorer. Both enable_raft and collect_training_data default to false in config/cli_config.yaml because RAFT collection was previously opt-out and silently wrote unexpected training_data/ files during normal runs.

nodes.label: Mandatory Protocols (from System_Instructions.md)
nodes.rationale: Pre-Flight: before any complex task, search System_Intructions.md for relevant rules, quote them in the plan, and state how compliance will happen. Verification: never mark a task done until file paths, naming conventions, and formatting are checked against established patterns. Chain-of-Verification: answer, generate verification questions, answer them, revise the original answer. Review Reports always saved to docs/reviews/Review_Comments_YYYY_MM_DD.md. Docstrings follow the Google Python Style Guide.

nodes.label: XHTML Test Infrastructure
nodes.rationale: All artifact text fields use XHTML format, so tests must build artifacts with tests/helpers/ functions (create_test_heading, create_test_requirement) rather than plain dict literals like {'type':'Heading','text':'Door System'}, and assertions must use substring checks (e.g. 'Door System' in artifact['heading']) since headings are XHTML-wrapped, not exact string matches.

nodes.label: Common Pitfalls (CLAUDE.md)
nodes.rationale: Symptom->cause->fix table: 'no text content' comes from bypassed attribute mapping (check _build_attribute_definition_mapping); Excel export crash in HP mode comes from wrong column count/name (verify 16 cols, 'LinkTest' not 'Tests'); vision model OOM from too much concurrency (lower --max-concurrent or disable vision); XHTML test mismatches from not using tests/helpers/; generate_test_cases AttributeError from using the wrong generator class (AsyncTestCaseGenerator has that method); TypeError expected str in validators on test_steps because the AI sometimes returns a list, fixed by validators.py joining with newline (do not change this pattern); unexpected training_data/ files come from RAFT collection previously being opt-out (now both enable_raft and collect_training_data default false).

nodes.label: Files Not to Modify Without Full Understanding
nodes.rationale: Enumerates the highest-risk symbols in the codebase (base_processor._build_augmented_requirements, extractors._build_attribute_definition_mapping/_extract_spec_object, formatters header list/StreamingTestCaseFormatter, ollama_client.generate_response_with_vision/AsyncOllamaClient semaphore, generators.extract_image_paths/stamp_validation_results/_postprocess_test_cases, deduplicator.DEFAULT_FIELDS_TO_COMPARE, image_extractor._validate_image/_preprocess_image/cleanup_extracted_images, config.enable_vision/get_model_for_requirement, yaml_prompt_manager.load_all_prompts/_selection_rules) with the reason each is critical. Line numbers drift; the symbol name is authoritative.

nodes.label: Test Layout & Markers
nodes.rationale: Tests live in tests/core (unit), tests/integration, tests/training, tests/unit, tests/performance, plus intentional root-level files (test_critical_improvements.py, test_integration_refactored.py, test_python314_ollama0125.py, test_refactoring.py) that must not be moved or duplicated into subdirectories. Markers: unit, integration, slow, async_test.

nodes.label: Hybrid AI Model Strategy (Gemini doc)
nodes.rationale: Optimizes for both speed and accuracy: text-only requirements are processed by a fast text model (llama3.1:8b); requirements with images are processed by a more powerful vision-capable model (llama3.2-vision:11b) for higher-quality analysis. Enabled by default; configurable in config/cli_config.yaml or disabled via enable_vision:false.

nodes.label: Git Branching Strategy (Gemini doc)
nodes.rationale: main = latest stable release; develop = integration branch for new features; feature/..., bugfix/..., release/... are the working branch prefixes; commit messages should follow Conventional Commits.

nodes.label: Modular Architecture Overview (Gemini doc)
nodes.rationale: Describes src/core (extraction/generation/formatting/vision-capable Ollama client), src/processors (standard vs high-performance async orchestration), src/prompts (templates), src/training (progressive curriculum + vision-aware RAFT), and main.py as the CLI entry point, built with Python 3.14+, Click, Rich, Pydantic, aiohttp, Pandas/Openpyxl, pytest, ruff, hatchling, torch/transformers.

nodes.label: Hybrid Vision Strategy v2.2.0 (README)
nodes.rationale: Requirements with images automatically use llama3.2-vision:11b (understands diagrams, state machines, interfaces); requirements without images use llama3.1:8b (faster text-only processing). No configuration needed — the system auto-detects images and selects the best model.

nodes.label: Context-Aware Processing (README)
nodes.rationale: System builds context per requirement from: heading context (current section heading), information context (related info blocks, resets per requirement), interface context (global system interfaces), and image context (extracted diagrams for vision analysis) — improving test case quality and relevance.

nodes.label: High-Performance Mode
nodes.rationale: Async/concurrent processing achieves ~65,000 artifacts/sec versus ~7,254 artifacts/sec standard sequential processing, a 9x speedup via proper resource management and memory optimization (__slots__, async/await, streaming formatters, intelligent model selection); enabled via --hp --max-concurrent N.

nodes.label: RAFT Training Custom Models Guide
nodes.rationale: RAFT collection is opt-in and disabled by default; enable via config/cli_config.yaml (training.enable_raft, training.collect_training_data) or env vars AI_TG_ENABLE_RAFT/AI_TG_COLLECT_TRAINING_DATA. Workflow: collect training data during normal runs -> annotate JSON in training_data/collected (mark oracle/distractor context and images) -> move to training_data/validated -> build dataset with utilities/build_vision_dataset.py -> train with utilities/train_vision_model.py -> deploy via OLLAMA__VISION_MODEL. Expected 40-60% better test case quality for requirements with diagrams; needs 12+ GB VRAM.

nodes.label: Vibe Coding Contributing Principles (README)
nodes.rationale: Readability first (code for humans, not machines); test-driven (write tests with implementation); simple over clever (avoid over-engineering); modern Python (use 3.14+ features, no legacy support). Points to System_Instructions.md for detailed coding guidelines.

nodes.label: Essential Reading (README doc index)
nodes.rationale: Points readers to CLAUDE.md as the comprehensive developer guide (architecture, critical code sections, testing) and to System_Intructions.md as the vibe coding principles and review guidelines document, plus docs/training/training_guideline.md for the RAFT vision training guide.

nodes.label: Test Suite Status (as of Nov 3, 2025)

nodes.label: Troubleshooting Table (README)
nodes.rationale: ModuleNotFoundError 'src' fixed by pip install -e .[dev]; OllamaConnectionError fixed by `ollama serve`; OllamaModelNotFoundError fixed by `ollama pull llama3.1:8b`; vision OOM fixed by OLLAMA__ENABLE_VISION=false; requirements skipped ('no text content') traced to REQIFZ attribute definitions.

nodes.rationale: Named presets bundling model + mode + options in Model.Mode[.Modifier] format (models: Llama31, Deepseek, Qwen; modes: Standard, HP; modifiers: Verbose, Debug, Fast, Quality), defined in profiles/profiles.yaml, invoked via --profile.

nodes.label: Core Protocols (Non-Negotiable)
nodes.rationale: Pre-Flight Protocol: search this document for keywords, quote relevant rules into the plan, state how compliance will happen. Verification Protocol: prohibited from marking a task 'Done' until a final self-correction check confirms file paths/naming conventions/formatting match established patterns. Chain-of-Verification: answer questions, generate verification questions, answer them separately, then revise the original answer.

nodes.label: Vibe Coding Guiding Principles
nodes.rationale: Readability counts: prefer explicit multi-line code over a clever one-liner. Simple over complex: avoid unnecessary abstraction layers. Explicit over implicit: descriptive, self-documenting names. Reasoning first, code second: explain why the change is necessary, the proposed approach, and discarded alternatives before writing code. Conflict Management: these Guiding Principles are the ultimate tie-breaker between conflicting instructions, favoring readable/simple/maintainable code aligned to core business logic.

nodes.label: Code Implementation Rules
nodes.rationale: Functions should be small, single-purpose, generally under 20-30 lines; use modern type hints and the typing module for complex types; no bare except clauses, catch specific exceptions; prefer @dataclass or Pydantic models over plain dictionaries for structured data.

nodes.label: Testing is Non-Negotiable
nodes.rationale: New functionality must ship with tests written alongside the implementation; bug fixes require first writing a failing test that reproduces the bug, then the code that makes it pass. Uses pytest for all tests. Coverage must include the happy path, edge cases, and expected error conditions.

nodes.label: Review Instructions
nodes.rationale: Comprehensive checklist for reviews: project layout/modularity/naming/imports/docstrings/type hints/error handling/performance/security/testing/logging/dead code, PEP 8 compliance, Python version compliance and backward-compatibility rejection, AI model usage checks (llama3.1:8b, deepseek-coder-v2:16b, llama3.2-vision, gemma3), prompt/context engineering efficiency, and design pattern/reusability review. Report must be saved with filename format Review_Comments_YYYY_MM_DD.md.

nodes.label: Documentation Instructions
nodes.rationale: Document the 'why', not the 'what' — assume the reader understands Python syntax and explain rationale, not mechanics. Every module/function/class/method needs a Google Python Style Guide docstring (summary, Args, Returns, Raises, Example). Maintain CHANGELOG.md under 'Keep a Changelog' format, adding an [Unreleased] entry (Added/Changed/Fixed/Removed) for every significant code change, kept in sync with the code in the same step.

PostToolUse Staleness Detection Hook
nodes.rationale: In Claude Code, a PostToolUse hook detects staleness after `git commit` and `git merge` and notifies the agent to run `analyze` — the hook deliberately does not run analyze itself, to avoid blocking the agent for up to 120s and risking KuzuDB corruption on timeout.

nodes.label: Shrink guard (#479) in to_json
nodes.rationale: to_json() returns False (writing nothing) when the newly built graph has fewer nodes than the existing graphify-out/graph.json, so a bad or partial re-extraction can never silently shrink a good graph; issue #479.

nodes.label: Empty-graph guard before write (#1392)
nodes.rationale: Immediately after build_from_json, if G.number_of_nodes() == 0 the pipeline aborts before any write, because an empty extraction (all files skipped, binary-only corpus, or a failed extraction) must never clobber an existing good graph.json/GRAPH_REPORT.md.

nodes.label: Mandatory parallel general-purpose subagent dispatch
nodes.rationale: Semantic extraction subagents must be dispatched as subagent_type=general-purpose (never Explore, which is read-only and cannot write chunk files to disk, silently dropping extraction results) and all in one message so they run in parallel; reading files one-by-one instead is 5-10x slower.

RAFT (Retrieval Augmented Fine-Tuning) Methodology
nodes.rationale: RAFT trains models to distinguish oracle (relevant) context from distractor (irrelevant) context retrieved by BaseProcessor._build_augmented_requirements, so the AI learns which heading/info/interface items matter for a given requirement rather than treating all retrieved context as equally important.

nodes.label: Vision RAFT Training
nodes.rationale: Extends RAFT methodology to hybrid vision/text models (llama3.2-vision:11b) so the system learns to prioritize relevant diagrams and ignore distractor images, aiming for 40-60% better test case quality for visual requirements without full fine-tuning.

nodes.label: Hybrid Vision/Text Model Selection Strategy
nodes.rationale: Auto-select the vision model only when a requirement has a successfully saved image, falling back to the text model otherwise, to avoid unnecessary VRAM usage and cost when no visual context exists.

nodes.label: Canonical Test-Case Schema Normalization
nodes.rationale: The pipeline should define one canonical test-case schema (preconditions/test_steps, the fields the active adaptive_default template actually produces) and normalize AI output to it in one place after JSON parsing, because divergent field expectations across the deduplicator, validator, parser, and formatter caused silent false-positive deletion of legitimate test cases and always-false validation checks.

nodes.label: Vision Image Preprocessing for Memory Management
nodes.rationale: Resize/downsample and compress images (max 1024px, JPEG quality 85) during extraction before base64 encoding, to cap memory spikes from concurrent vision requests (achieved ~75% reduction, from ~216MB worst case to ~54MB) and avoid OOM crashes.

nodes.label: Mandatory Test-Case JSON Schema (summary_suffix/preconditions/test_steps/expected_result/test_type)
